tuning.note: Per-car fixes found by the car QA pipeline (track-viewer/CAR-QA.md). Applied by track-viewer/src/cars.js at assembly, so the sandbox and the race show the same car.
tuning.model: assets/cars/blackbird/source.json (scripts/model-car.py): its own canopy, mirrors and wheels; mirrors/interior/glass tuning does not apply
log: 2026-10-20: new car from the Sketchfab Hennessey Blackbird model (let's not care abt it, CC-BY); no car-lab profile, everything from model.json

run 1: the tyres were 3 cm into the arches and 5.8 cm in the dive (the model's arches are tight) -> ride 0.065; rear tyre face sits 0.5 m outside the tub (open rear fenders by design): the poke warning stays; mirror glass is the model's Material.020; Material.001 (rear wing sails) wears the paint

checks.title: No see-through gaps (every part in place)
checks.fix: automatic interior fills (carkit/interior.js: floor, keel, bays, bulkheads, arch liners, cabin); trace a gap that survives them (masks.png, then a magenta-background render) and add a fill or a tuning.glass scale

checks.title: Glass fills the window openings (advisory)
checks.fix: car-lab profile glass polygons (read-only) or tuning.glass { push, offset } here

checks.title: Tyres sit in the arches: a visible gap, no clipping, flush with the body
checks.value: front: clear 0.021 top 0.026 poke 0.062; front: clear 0.021 top 0.026 poke 0.062; rear: clear 0.061 top 0.073 poke 0.504; rear: clear 0.061 top 0.073 poke 0.504
checks.expect: clearance ≥ 0 (lip overlap under 2 cm warns), top gap 1.2-12 cm, poke -10..+4 cm
checks.fix: tuning.suspension { ride } raises the body off the wheels (m); arch lips that dip into the tyre need a shell fix

checks.title: Glass sits in the openings, not on top of the paint or under it
checks.fix: tuning.glass { push } (m, along the pane normal)

checks.title: Exhaust and nitro points sit on the rear surface with a clear exit
checks.value: 4 points, 0 off the body or blocked, asymmetry 0 m
checks.expect: on the surface (−4..+8 cm), unblocked, mirror-symmetric
checks.fix: assets/cars/exhaust.json tips [y, z] (and up for top exits); ?debug=exhaust shows them

checks.title: Side mirrors: real-style housings, both sides, symmetric, on short arms
checks.value: the model's own, asymmetry 0 m, housing gap -0.018 / -0.018 m
checks.expect: tuned style, asymmetry ≤ 2 cm, gap 1.5-32 cm
checks.fix: tuning.mirrors { style: blade|gt|bullet, scale, offset, housing }

checks.title: Tail lamps: red but unlit off the brake, bright and blooming on it
checks.value: area 904 cm2; dusk b0: 59.6, dusk b1: 142.5, night b0: 46.4, night b1: 165.1
checks.expect: off: lum < 125, red; on: ≥ 90 and ≥ off + 40 (saturated red has low luminance; glossy lenses mirror the sky when off)
checks.fix: carkit/lamps.js (levels are shared; area-normalised); tuning.lamps only for a real exception

checks.title: Premium look against the reference (judged by eye: look.png, reference.png)
checks.expect: as good as the Endurance garage frames
checks.fix: finishes.json (paint), tuning.mirrors, lamps; geometry limits need a better source model

checks.title: Tyres stay clear of the arches with the nose down
checks.fix: tuning.suspension { pitch } lower, or { ride } higher

checks.title: Active aero (none set for this car)
checks.expect: only for cars that have it
